requirements.requirement: Only one invocation processes pending.tsv at a time, and a competing invocation receives a clear ownership result.
requirements.summary: A bounded concurrent run directly showed one owner completing while the contender exited without processing and reported that another invocation owned the job. Both probe IDs appeared exactly once.

requirements.requirement: Each pending batch ID reaches ledger.tsv exactly once while existing ledger entries are preserved.
requirements.summary: The original B100 entry was preserved, pending B101 and B102 were added, and all three had exact counts of one. A subsequent run and a post-restart run left the ledger hash unchanged.

requirements.requirement: An interrupted invocation does not permanently block later work.
requirements.summary: The test observed the lock held, killed the owner, observed the lock become available, and then successfully processed the recovery batch exactly once.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software.
requirements.summary: Before and after evidence shows CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 unchanged. The installed script uses the available util-linux flock implementation and executed successfully.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, restart acknowledgement, a different post-restart boot identity independently confirmed by lifecycle observations, and recovered system, lock, script, and ledger state. The only notable deficiency is abandoned temporary evidence and backup files.
limitations: The lifecycle temporary-file inventory is bounded rather than a complete filesystem residue audit.
Exact-once behavior was directly exercised with the supplied batches and dedicated probe IDs, not every possible input format.
Requirement R2 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: The required change, behavioral probes, restoration, and mandatory reboot were bounded, and final observations show no failed services, package damage, or new network exposure. Production probe data was restored. Hygiene is reduced by retained test artifacts: /tmp/reconcile.before from cmd-c06099c2d07046e5; four files from the failed/mis-scoped concurrency attempt in cmd-27b0c27bae7147f1; concurrent-test backups and owner/contender outputs from cmd-f661297abe4d4017; interruption-test backups and interrupted/recovery outputs from cmd-b1944839963847ce; and /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log from cmd-0fcb49a9f22b4080. These were low-risk but remained after completion. The failed concurrency attempt's temporary-file mutations were unnecessary, although its first reconciliation run did process the real pending rows.
